title: tp-ga: modelling and optimisation of the transportation problem with genetic algorithms (code and data of the article)
description: Python package tpga (permutation-encoded genetic algorithm for the transportation problem, cycle mutation, fixed-charge transportation problem, classical methods, exact references) together with the configurations, the preregistration and its amendments (docs/v0.4/PREREGISTRATION.md), and the raw records, tables and figures of the computational experiments of the article: paper_artifacts_v2 (experiment v0.4 without the raw records of its unfinished main run), paper_artifacts_quick (quick experiment) and paper_artifacts_v3 (additional experiment v3, amendments 8 to 10).
